//: P2 SN-5: static type coverage for scripts/ (validator scripts).
Extends root tsconfig (strict, jsx react-jsx, moduleResolution bundler, @/* paths).
include adds 'src' because scripts import src symbols relatively — they must share one program.
allowImportingTsExtensions: scripts import './lib/ci-data-guard.ts' with explicit .ts suffix (legal under noEmit).

lib deviation from root (ES2020 -> ES2023): validator scripts run on Node >=20 and already use String.replaceAll (ES2021) and Array.at (ES2022) at runtime; root src stays on ES2020 for the browser bundle.
scripts/*.mjs (e.g. validate-static-all.mjs) are intentionally OUT of scope: allowJs stays off; they are plain JS runners, not typed validators.
Wired into validate:governance:full + CI static-gates, NOT the ~16s pre-commit hook (kept fast by design).
